scope: Three selected independent completed native TRAIN episodes from CEM07 generation1 and CEM08 generation0. No formal acceptance.
opening_title: 当前真实效果｜7.52米/秒回球与最新失败
opening_lines: 回合一：空中拍线出球7.52米/秒，实际越网；落点和恢复失败。
回合二：空中拍线接触后合格恢复2.92秒，但球被网挡住。
回合三：最新前移方案在击球前触网失败。三段均为独立回合。
closing_lines: 当前完整球拍模型仍未完成合格扣杀；保留真实失败。
速度≥8米/秒、向下出球、目标落点与稳定恢复尚未同时达标。
画面来自实际原生全身轨迹；正式A/B各200回合尚未运行。
caveats: Selected TRAIN episodes do not establish a success rate or formal A/B acceptance.
The three cases are independent; their partial achievements must not be combined into one success.
CEM08 generation0 is complete, but its four-generation search was still running at snapshot time.
Native poses are sampled at50Hz and replayed without interpolation; contact stills use exact recorded native substep poses.
The net-blocked second case has no observed first-ground result; no landing is invented.
First-landing markers use actual first-ground events and adjacent50Hz body poses. Ball motion after first ground is hidden.
Recorded solver speed overshoots are retained. Latest failure case env4 recorded maximum joint speed31.7278rad/s against configured leg speed30rad/s; this is not a hardware-limit validation.
